The '''multi-weapon''' was a [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee weapon]] designed specifically for [[Infiltrators/Legends|Infiltrators]]. It was an attempt to cut down on the weight of their equipment by combining three weapons into one tool. One end contains a weighted [[Club/Legends|club]], the other a sliding [[Dagger/Legends|dagger]] secured by a twist lock, and a coiled [[Garrote/Legends|garrote]]. Variations on the tool replace the garrote with a [[Slicewire/Legends|Slicewire]].
